user.title: Configure room
user.description: Select thermostats and an external temperature sensor for a room.

advanced.title: Room control
advanced.description: Every contact must be closed before heat resumes. The calibration interval is always enforced (at least 300 seconds).

data.window_sensors: Window and door contacts (or contact groups)

device.title: Configure thermostat
device.description: Settings for {thermostat}. Empty calibration fields allow automatic detection of a number entity on the same device. MQTT requires a known offset in the climate attributes.

data.temperature_is_calibrated: Internal reading already includes calibration offset

data_description.temperature_is_calibrated: Disable if the internal sensor reports an uncalibrated raw measurement.
data_description.regulated_mode: TV01/TV02 use heat. Choose auto for firmware whose heat mode permanently opens the valve.

error.invalid_trvs: Select distinct, registered physical climate entities.
error.invalid_sensor: Select a temperature sensor with a valid value and unit.
error.trv_in_use: A thermostat is already assigned to another room.
error.invalid_windows: A selected contact does not exist.
error.ambiguous_calibration: Choose either a number entity or an MQTT topic.
error.invalid_topic: Use a full topic ending in /set/local_temperature_calibration without MQTT wildcards.
error.invalid_bounds: The minimum offset must be smaller than the maximum.
error.unsupported_mode: This HVAC mode is not supported by the thermostat.
error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist or has the wrong domain.
error.mqtt_unavailable: Set up the MQTT integration before configuring an MQTT topic.
error.unsupported_temperature: This target is outside a thermostat’s supported temperature range.
